title: What Is Litecoin? The Coin Built to Be Bitcoin's Faster Cousin (30 Seconds)

scenes.head: COIN EXPLAINER
scenes.hook: WHAT IS LITECOIN? BITCOIN'S FASTER COUSIN
scenes.narration: What is Litecoin? Bitcoin's faster cousin.

scenes.head: WHAT IT IS
scenes.narration: Charlie Lee, a former Google engineer, released Litecoin in twenty eleven. It copies Bitcoin's design with a few tweaks.

scenes.head: HOW IT WORKS
scenes.narration: Litecoin targets a new block every two and a half minutes, so payments confirm faster than on Bitcoin.

scenes.head: THE SUPPLY
scenes.narration: Supply is capped at eighty four million coins, and the mining reward is cut in half on a schedule.

scenes.head: THE LIMIT
scenes.hook: CRITICS: FEW APPS BUILT ON IT
scenes.narration: Critics say Litecoin has a much smaller app ecosystem than Ethereum, so it is mainly used for payments.
